CVE-2024-56378.title: libpoppler.so in Poppler through 24.12.0 has an out-of-bounds rea ...
CVE-2024-56378.description: libpoppler.so in Poppler through 24.12.0 has an out-of-bounds read vulnerability within the JBIG2Bitmap::combine function in JBIG2Stream.cc.

CVE-2024-6239.title: A flaw was found in the Poppler's Pdfinfo utility. This issue occ ...
CVE-2024-6239.description: A flaw was found in the Poppler's Pdfinfo utility. This issue occurs when using -dests parameter with pdfinfo utility. By using certain malformed input files, an attacker could cause the utility to crash, leading to a denial of service.

CVE-2025-32364.title: A floating-point exception in the PSStack::roll function of Poppl ...
CVE-2025-32364.description: A floating-point exception in the PSStack::roll function of Poppler before 25.04.0 can cause an application to crash when handling malformed inputs associated with INT_MIN.

CVE-2025-32365.title: Poppler before 25.04.0 allows crafted input files to trigger out- ...
CVE-2025-32365.description: Poppler before 25.04.0 allows crafted input files to trigger out-of-bounds reads in the JBIG2Bitmap::combine function in JBIG2Stream.cc because of a misplaced isOk check.

CVE-2025-43718.title: Poppler 24.06.1 through 25.x before 25.04.0 allows stack consumpt ...
CVE-2025-43718.description: Poppler 24.06.1 through 25.x before 25.04.0 allows stack consumption and a SIGSEGV via deeply nested structures within the metadata (such as GTS_PDFEVersion) of a PDF document, e.g., a regular expression for a long pdfsubver string. This occurs in Dict::lookup, Catalog::getMetadata, and associated functions in PDFDoc, with deep recursion in the regex executor (std::__detail::_Executor).
